title: Item:Official Guild Charter
wikitext:
[[File:Official Guild Charter.png|thumb|right|upright|420px|Official Guild Charter]]
Stamped and signed by all the proper authorities, this official charter allows you to found a [[guild]], invite people to join, and name guild officers.

You can communicate with your guild through guild chat. This charter is good for one use only.

* Acquired by:
** [[Premium]] and [[Free to Play]] need to purchase the Official Guild Charter from the [[DDO Store]], [[Bound to Account]].
** [[VIP]] '''DO NOT''' have to purchase the Official Guild Charter to found a guild.

* Limitations
** The Official Guild Charter can only be use once.
** [[Premium]] and [[Free to Play]] accounts will need to purchase an Official Guild Charter from the DDO Store to be able to create a Guild.
** A guild's name may not be changed after creation unless one uses the Guild Rename Paid Service.
